description: Resolve one Zenodo deposit from a record id, a Zenodo DOI (10.5281/zenodo.N), a concept DOI or concept record id (resolves to the latest version), another DOI deposited on Zenodo, or a zenodo.org or doi.org URL, and return its full metadata: description, creators with ORCIDs and ROR affiliations, license, access and embargo, funding and grants, related identifiers, communities, version position, usage counts, and the first 25 files. Optionally includes a formatted citation. A miss (an unknown id, a deleted record with its removal tombstone, restricted metadata, or a DOI not registered on Zenodo) returns found: false with guidance instead of an error.

citation_style.description: Include a formatted citation of the resolved version: bibtex, csl-json, or a text style (apa, chicago-author-date, harvard-cite-them-right, ieee, modern-language-association, nature). Case, spaces, hyphens, and underscores are ignored when matching (BibTeX, APA, CSL JSON). Omit for none.

id.description: The deposit to resolve: a record id (22705923), a Zenodo DOI (10.5281/zenodo.22705923, doi: prefix and any case accepted), a concept DOI or concept record id such as 10.5281/zenodo.591564 (resolves to the latest version), another DOI registered to a Zenodo record, or a zenodo.org/records or doi.org URL.

name: zenodo_get_record

citation.description: The formatted citation. Present when requested and found.

citation_style.description: The citation style used. Present with citation.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_identifier`: id matches no accepted form, or is a GitHub-badge latestdoi id or a non-zenodo.org host. `record_unavailable`: Zenodo could not serve this record: HTTP 500 after one retry, HTTP 500 while resolving a non-Zenodo DOI, or no complete response within the time budget (its gateway cuts off near 30 s, which deposits with about 10,000 or more files hit). `rate_limited`: Zenodo answered HTTP 429, or this server's shared Zenodo request budget is spent for the current window. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

guidance.description: What to do next. Present when not found.

input_kind.description: How id was parsed: record_id (digits), zenodo_doi (10.5281/zenodo.N or zenodo.N), external_doi (another DOI), or url (a zenodo.org or doi.org link).

miss_kind.description: Why nothing resolved. Present when not found.

notice.description: File access notes or a pointer to zenodo_list_files.

embargo_active.description: True while an embargo is in force.

files.description: File access: public or restricted; absent when not reported.

record.description: Record (metadata) access: public or restricted; absent when not reported.

status.description: open, restricted, embargoed, or metadata-only (unknown if Zenodo omits it).

type.description: Description type, e.g. Notes or Methods.

code_repository.description: Source code repository URL; absent when none is linked.

communities.description: Up to 25 communities holding this record.

concept_doi.description: Concept DOI of the version series; absent for external DOIs.

concept_recid.description: Concept record id naming the whole version series; absent if Zenodo omits it.

orcid.description: ORCID iD, when the depositor supplied one.
ORCID iD, when the depositor supplied one.

description.description: Description converted from HTML to plain text, capped at 4,000 characters; absent when the record has none.

description_length.description: Full plain-text length of the description in characters. Present with description.

description_truncated.description: True when the description was cut at 4,000 characters. Present with description.

doi.description: DOI of this version; absent on some old records.

count.description: Total files; absent when files are restricted or embargoed.

total_bytes.description: Total file size in bytes; absent when files are restricted or embargoed.

funding.description: Up to 50 funding entries (funders and grants).

oai_id.description: OAI-PMH identifier; absent when not assigned.

publication_date.description: Publication date (EDTF as given: 2026-09-11, 2020, 2020-05); absent when not recorded.

publisher.description: Publisher as deposited (usually Zenodo); absent when not set.

identifier.description: The related identifier (DOI, arXiv id, URL, PMID, …).

relation.description: Relation type id, e.g. issupplementto or cites.

resource_type.description: Resource type id of the related item.

scheme.description: Identifier scheme, e.g. doi, arxiv, url.

resource_type.description: Resource type; absent when not recorded.

id.description: Resource type id, e.g. dataset or publication-article.

title.description: Resource type label, when Zenodo supplies one.

revision.description: Record revision id; absent when not reported.

rights.description: Licenses and rights. Files carry the deposit’s license.

id.description: License id (custom rights may lack one).

stats.description: Unique views and downloads for this version and for the whole series; absent when Zenodo reports no usage counts.

downloads.description: Unique downloads, as zenodo.org displays them; absent when not reported.

views.description: Unique views, as zenodo.org displays them; absent when not reported.

downloads.description: Unique downloads, as zenodo.org displays them; absent when not reported.

views.description: Unique views, as zenodo.org displays them; absent when not reported.

version.description: Version label as deposited; absent when the depositor set none.

index.description: Position of this version in its series (1 = first); absent if Zenodo omits version data.

is_latest.description: True when this is the newest version; absent if Zenodo omits version data.

latest_recid.description: Record id of the newest version, when this one is not it.

resolved_from.description: How the record was reached: a version id, a concept id resolved to the latest version, or a non-Zenodo DOI. Present when found.

tombstone.description: Removal tombstone. Present when miss_kind is deleted.

citation_text.description: The citation the tombstone still serves — the only bibliographic data a deleted record keeps.

removal_reason.description: Removal reason id, e.g. spam or retracted.

truncated.description: True when the record has more files than the 25 shown.

title: Get a Zenodo record
